text.en:
The sitios of Tigman, Belnas, Cacao, and Binatagan in the Municipality of Sipocot, Province of
Camarines Sur, are constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality to be known as the
barrio of Tible.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 5, 1959.
